q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a toothbrush?
title: Toothbrush carbon footprint per brush
short: Weigh the handle and bristles per brush and multiply the PP and nylon by supplier figures, then add the pack. Add moulding, tufting and packing energy, then divide the plant's energy by brushes made.

ul: PP handle, sometimes with a rubber grip.

p: Report per brush including its pack, which can weigh as much as the brush.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per brush (one month)
lines: Plant total: 21,300 / 2,000,000 = 0.0106 kg CO2 per brush
Add resin, nylon and pack for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
